values.value: Finds: Active Product2 records whose blng__TaxRule__c lookup is null. Why it matters: Without a tax rule the billing engine cannot calculate tax on quote lines or invoices that include this product. You either under-bill the customer (lost revenue) or block invoice generation (operational stall) — and you risk tax-jurisdiction non-compliance on audit. Suppress a finding: when a specific product is genuinely tax-exempt (registered charity SKU, government-only contract). Note the exemption reason and dismiss that one row. Disable the detector: only if your business model is 100% tax-exempt across every SKU AND you've set blng__TaxableYesNo__c = No on every active product. Most orgs should leave this on.
